scope: Independent discovery checks: retained choices verified through HTTP/GPX on snapshot1b044, and exact original-start engine walks on corrected snapshotf349. Same frozen requests and explicit road defaults. Timing is descriptive; search may remain unfinished after successful recovery.
limitations: not_observed means no exact original-start walk or direct85%-full-and-cycle representative was observed among retained app choices before stopping; not absence, completed enumeration, or proof that no merely similar raw engine candidate was emitted.

A similar representative can have a different start and is never labeled exact witness recovery. Its HTTP geometry and GPX match independently reconstructed snapshot profiles; raw sources for its extra sections were not separately reaudited.
Progress is the last throttled published snapshot. The very fast PassLakes recovery ended before a progress update, so zero attempted/expansion counters are stale rather than no work.
RSS covers server, worker threads, HTTP measurement client and independent verifier. Browser and other processes are excluded. Guards are sampled cooperative measurement bounds.

Timing, throughput and RSS are descriptive; cache state and concurrent machine activity were uncontrolled. Root final offline verification ran concurrently with part of trail-first Paradise-short. A code difference and changed counts alone are not a general performance claim.

Depth-layer HTTP checks found similar representatives at different starts, not exact original-start walks. Exact recovery is separately measured before app similarity filtering by the engine checks below.

Current-data engine observations use snapshotf349, whose only start changes are two independently verified restored parking contacts. All eligible starts for each original query are searched; the runner does not direct search toward its witness.

Engine RSS excludes the HTTP server, retained app choices and browser. Witness recovery does not prove complete enumeration, recreational usefulness of every output, or availability of alternate starts in the app.

decision.remaining: All seven qualifying source witnesses have now been recovered exactly by the engine (six within60seconds, Sunrise-long in214.244seconds in a separate300second observation). This proves discovery of these fixed routes, not complete enumeration. App similarity filtering can suppress meaningful alternate starts even when the engine recovers them. Coverage limits, route-family presentation, broader fresh-source validation and automatic delivery remain unfinished.
